messages:
sam_support: FYI customer 'FormFlow' just opened a high-priority ticket — function calls started failing right after our v2.12 canary. They see schema validation errors for tool args (image payloads getting rejected). @rachel_ml @devon_eng can you take a look?

rachel_ml: Thanks, are they on hosted or dedicated? Any example payloads or error logs?

sam_support: Hosted. Customer pasted this error: `400 schema_error: invalid string for property "image": expected base64` and the request body we received looked like this:

```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-v2.12-canary",
  "input": "call_tool",
  "tool": "image-annotate",
  "args": {"image": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUg..."}
}
```

But our validator logs show the `image` field as starting with `data:\u001f\u0008` instead of `data:image/png;base64,`. So something is mangling the prefix during tool selection/serialization.

devon_eng: Huh. That smells like an encoding/tokenization change in v2.12 that affects tool-arg stringification. I pulled a failing request sample and saw non-printable bytes inserted right before the `,base64` comma. Might be internal whitespace normalization or a new prompt preprocessor. Repro steps: send same payload to redwood-v2.11 (works) and redwood-v2.12-canary (fails).

rachel_ml: Can you paste the raw request/response pair from the canary? Any indication the model itself mutated the arg vs our runtime?

sam_support: Raw request attached in ticket but here's the server-side captured tool call we logged after model selection: `tool_call_args: '{"image":"data:\u001f\u0008image/png;base64,iVBOR..."}'` — note the `\u001f\u0008` bytes.

devon_eng: Confirmed. Two hypotheses: (1) v2.12 changed how it encodes tool-call string outputs (old versions used plain string), (2) our JSON encoder/escape path is mishandling bytes in the new model response. Need quick repro harness to differentiate.

julia_cs: Customer impact: their ingest job triggers ~300 errors/min during peak, so it's blocking onboarding. They asked for ETA on a fix or rollback.

anna_prodops: We need to decide: immediate rollback of canary for tool-enabled models or hotfix. Suggest rollback traffic for model family `redwood-v2.12*` for any endpoints that do tool/function calls while we investigate. That will buy time and limit blast radius. @ops_oncall any objections?

ops_oncall: No objections. I'll prepare a rollback plan. Do we want a partial rollback (only hosted API) or global?

devon_eng: Partial hosted rollback is fine as mitigation. Root cause likely model-side output formatting; even if we patch runtime, we should notify model team. I'll start a small repro script comparing v2.11 vs v2.12 for the same prompt and tool metadata.

deploy-bot: deploy_request: rollback redwood-v2.12-canary -> redwood-v2.11 for model routing (scope: hosted tool-enabled endpoints). Request queued by ops_oncall.

rachel_ml: Please also capture token stream diffs and any appended control bytes from v2.12. If model output includes non-UTF8 markers that's a model release regression. Tagging @devon_eng and @rachel_ml on the model onboarding PR that landed the new tokenizer changes.

sam_support: I told the customer we're working it and expect either a rollback or patch in the next 2 hours. They asked for a temporary workaround — is there a server-side filter we can add to strip leading control bytes before base64 validation?

devon_eng: We can add a quick sanitizer at the tool invocation layer to strip any non-printable prefix from `args.image` before schema validate. Quick, but risky (may hide other issues). Prefer rollback + deep fix. If we do sanitizer, limit to hosted canary traffic only and add logging.

anna_prodops: Ops: proceed with rollback for hosted canary. Devon: start sanitizer patch on a branch in parallel in case rollback doesn't fully cover their tenant. Keep it feature-flagged and monitored. Julia: update the customer with rollback ETA 15m and share workaround if they still see errors.

julia_cs: Noted — updating FormFlow. They want a postmortem when resolved.

ops_oncall: Rollback to v2.11 completed for hosted tool calls at 2123460000. Monitoring metrics now.

deploy-bot: deploy_event: rollback applied by ops_oncall at 2123460000 -> routing healthy.

sam_support: Customer confirms errors dropped to zero after rollback. They re-ran the job and no schema errors. :relieved:

devon_eng: I'll finish the repro harness and open an issue against the model onboarding change. If it's model output, model team needs to revert or fix serialization; if it's our encoder, we'll patch with sanitizer + tests.

rachel_ml: Filing model-team issue now and cc-ing release owner. We'll coordinate a canary re-intro only after a fix and new tests.

julia_cs: Thanks team — I'll schedule a short postmortem and share notes with the customer.

anna_prodops: Good work. Keep this thread updated with RCA link and rollback timeline in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
